name: 32724 · Deland, FL
findings: ZIP 32724 (Deland) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32724 (Deland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32724 (Deland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
